method: Read-only project lifecycle code, existing safe transport observations, and destination-filtered existing local Clash Verge service logs. No provider HTTP, proxy writes, credential export, or original log export.

lifecycle_findings.model_client_scope: Per Runtime; sole manager, zero children in this actual task. Service configuration-check client is a separate closed instance with no model request.
lifecycle_findings.close_order: Transport body read fails, then model_error and agent_failed are recorded; Runtime finally closes its client afterwards.
lifecycle_findings.payload: Session payload is copied, body send completes before receiving response, no overlapping manager completion call found.
lifecycle_findings.cancellation: Project separately records CancelledError; HTTPX exception mapping catches Exception and does not map asyncio CancelledError to RemoteProtocolError.
unused_paths: terminal-tail drain not entered because no terminal event
8 MiB body limit and 20000 event limit not reached

existing_local_route_logs.association_basis: Same destination hostname and timestamps near each isolated A first request; log rows lack application request/response IDs, so correlation is not ID-level proof.
existing_local_route_logs.meaning_of_original_environment_route: Application proxy environment was retained. This does not freeze the independently running proxy application's selected upstream route.
limits: Info-level connect entries do not show the failure-time close/error or identify the hop that ended the HTTP body.
Different route labels are not proof that a particular route caused failure.
Absent unprivileged lsof output does not prove the proxy was stopped.
Current configuration is not retroactive proof of historical routing.
existing_local_route_logs.historical_direct_boundary: Historical v13 direct describes explicit HTTPX environment-proxy bypass, not a blanket claim about all OS-level routing.

conclusion: No project lifecycle fault explains the observed 290-second failure. The incomplete HTTP response is established; the failing network hop remains unproven. No transport protection or default route was changed.
